items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Reginald Forsythe wrote that. Reginald Forsythe, he's a black man.

ctx.x: And of course, Earl was on every night at midnight from the Grand Terrace in those days, in the thirties. He's come on there with "Deep Forest," his theme song. Reginald Forsythe wrote that. Reginald Forsythe, he's a black man.
